islands.description: A compact mainland with a broad interior, uneven headlands and small offshore islets.
A narrow mainland whose long spine follows its own heading, with coves along both flanks.
A curved mainland wraps around a large bay that remains connected to the open sea.
Two broad lobes join across a narrower waist, giving the mainland two distinct ends.
Irregular headlands and deep coves surround a rough interior and a scatter of satellite islets.
Low reef islands trace a broken rim around a shallow lagoon with open ocean channels.
